newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat condemns Tel Aviv blast, spokesman says.
newsitem.headline: Arafat condemns Tel Aviv blast, spokesman says.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat condemned a blast at a Tel Aviv cafe on Friday, calling it a "terrorist incident," a spokesman said.

Spokesman Marwan Kanafani told Reuters that Arafat called Israel's President Ezer Weizman and said: "I am very disturbed with the violence that took place today and I condemn this terrorist incident".
Arafat tried to call Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu who was on his way to the site of the blast in Tel Aviv, the spokesman said.

Israeli security officials had warned that Palestinian violence, including possible suicide attacks, could erupt this week in anger at Netanyahu's groundbreaking on a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
